parameters.content:
## Block 1: Pipeline A (DDC Converter)
- Converts .ifc to .xlsx, parses the wide table, and filters out spatial entities.
- Reuses a cached conversion when one exists; a conversion failure halts the run.
- Full float precision preserved.

## Block 2: Pipeline B (IfcOpenShell)
- Fetches and verifies the Python extraction script, then extracts elements, properties, quantities and materials as JSON.
- Detects the IFC schema version and the domain; the schema identifier selects the rule set used downstream.
- Resolves material names, not just IDs.

## Block 0: Setup
- Sets paths, the BQI dimension weights, the uncertainty coefficient α, and the coverage threshold. All tunable parameters live here.
- Set project_file_b to run the dual-file configuration, in which Pipeline B reads a different file from Pipeline A.

# Uncertainty-Aware Risk Screening from Imperfect Building Information Models: Schema Validation, Quantity Take-Off Robustness, and Explainable Risk Registers in an n8n Workflow
DataDrivenConstruction [GitHub](https://github.com/datadrivenconstruction/cad2data-Revit-IFC-DWG-DGN-pipeline-with-conversion-validation-qto)
N8N Thesis Documentation [N8N-Thesis](https://github.com/ulnirah/n8n-thesis)
IFC Sample [buildingSMART](https://github.com/buildingSMART/Sample-Test-Files.git)

## Block 3: QTO Comparison + BQI Scoring
- Merges both pipelines on GlobalId and compares every shared quantity field.
- Scores each element on D1 completeness, D2 validity, D3 QTO coverage and D4 cross-pipeline agreement.
- Element coverage and per-field cross-pipeline SRCC are computed separately from the BQI.

parameters.content:
## Block 5: Output Generation
- Writes the HTML risk register with the screening verdict, per-dimension evidence and cross-pipeline verification.
- Exports the per-element sensitivity dataset as JSON for offline analysis.
- Diagnostic dumps for pipelines A and B, BQI and risk are written alongside.

## Block 4: Risk screening
- Derives exposure, likelihood and consequence per element from IFC properties.
- Widens the raw risk score into a band whose width is set by α(1 − BQI); ranks on the upper edge R_adj.
- Labels each element High, Medium or Low against per-model thresholds.
